subject.title: improve(chat): make prose and simple lists one selectable text block

question: Should the tray retain a scoped first-class `RichTextBlock` primitive in FunctionalUI for this selection improvement, or should this UX change wait for an agreed Reactor/alternative UI direction?
rationale: The patch appears bounded and tested, but it deliberately expands a bespoke UI abstraction while the related architecture direction remains an open maintainer decision.

options.title: Accept the scoped primitive
options.body: Merge the focused renderer and reconciler addition, with the new UI-thread contract test preserving selection and island boundaries.

options.title: Defer to UI architecture work
options.body: Pause this PR and decide the Reactor or replacement abstraction first, then reapply the selection behavior through that approved surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the scoped primitive
recommendation.body: Merge the focused renderer and reconciler addition, with the new UI-thread contract test preserving selection and island boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: The recorded review already calibrated the native-proof requirement and is the strongest available signal on acceptance of this UI direction.
